testMessages.title: Production Outage (Should be High)
testMessages.message: Our entire platform is down. None of our customers can log in and we're losing sales every minute. This needs to be fixed immediately.

testMessages.title: Simple Feature Request (Should be Low)
testMessages.message: It would be really nice if I could export my data as a CSV file. Not urgent, just a thought!

expectedResults.recommendedAction: Log in the product backlog and share with the product team

testMessages.title: Billing Confusion (Should be Medium)
testMessages.message: I was charged twice this month for my subscription. Can someone look into this and let me know what happened?

expectedResults.recommendedAction: Direct to billing portal or billing team

testMessages.title: Angry All-Caps Message (Should be High, not Low)
testMessages.message: MY ACCOUNT HAS BEEN LOCKED FOR THREE DAYS AND NO ONE IS RESPONDING TO MY EMAILS. THIS IS COMPLETELY UNACCEPTABLE.

expectedResults.note: Old urgency scorer incorrectly reduced score for ALL CAPS — AI handles this correctly now

testMessages.title: Positive Feedback with Exclamation Marks (Should be Low)
testMessages.message: Just wanted to say your support team is absolutely incredible!!! They solved my issue in under 10 minutes! Amazing service!!!

expectedResults.note: Old urgency scorer inflated score due to '!!!' — AI recognizes this as positive feedback

testMessages.title: General How-To Question (Should be Low)
testMessages.message: Hi, I just signed up and I'm not sure how to invite other team members to my workspace. Is there a guide for that?

expectedResults.recommendedAction: Respond with FAQ or help center link

testMessages.title: Payment Failure Blocking Access (Should be High)
testMessages.message: My credit card payment failed and now I can't access any of my projects. I have a client demo in two hours and I really need this resolved.

expectedResults.note: Billing issue with time pressure and access blocked — should escalate

testMessages.title: Minor UI Bug (Should be Medium)
testMessages.message: The dark mode toggle doesn't seem to save my preference. Every time I refresh the page it resets back to light mode. Bit annoying but not a dealbreaker.

expectedResults.recommendedAction: Gather reproduction steps and log for engineering team
